contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP] CAESAR TRAIAN HADRIA[NVS] AVG ; R/ PM TR P[--] COS III

Silver coin. Denarius of Hadrian (117-138), as kindly identified by the finder; possibly RIC vol. 2 page 350 no. 80, issue of mint of Rome, 119-122, Reece period 6. Obverse description: Bust laureate bare-shouldered right, seen from front. Obverse inscription: [IMP] CAESAR TRAIAN HADRIA[NVS] AVG. Reverse description: Draped and crowned male figure standing left with cornucopiae, right hand extended ?holding scales. Reverse inscription: PM TR P[--] COS III. Diameter: 18.4mm, Weight: 2.84gms, die axis: 6
